slides.h1: Users can post in your app? Plan for this.
slides.lead: Apple has a specific checklist for apps with user content.
Users agree to them before they can post. Make them easy to find.
On every post, comment and profile. One or two taps, not a hunt.
Someone bothering you should disappear from your feed. Instantly.

slides.h2: A plan to filter and act fast.
slides.lead: Know who reviews reports and how quickly bad content comes down.
A support email or page that someone actually answers.

slides.h2: Safety isn't a feature you add later. It's the base.
slides.lead: Nabor is a community app for neighbors in the same building. Trust is the whole product.
